types.name: InkPoint
types.doc: A sampled point: position in pad units, pen pressure between 0 and 1 (or -1 when the device has none), and ms since the stroke began.

members.name: at
members.doc: When the stroke began, in ms. Replay keeps the real rhythm between strokes.

members.name: size
members.doc: Diameter of the stroke at half pressure, in pad units.

members.name: thinning
members.doc: How much pressure changes the width, from 0 to 1.

members.name: streamline
members.doc: How far each point trails the pointer, from 0 to 1. Higher is smoother but lags more.

members.name: simulatePressure
members.doc: Derive pressure from speed when the device reports none: fast is thin, slow is full.

members.name: taperStart
members.doc: Length over which the start and the end taper, in pad units.

members.name: last
members.doc: False while the stroke is still being drawn, so the end does not taper yet.

types.name: SignaturePadProps
types.doc: A signature field with real ink. Width follows pen pressure, or speed for a mouse or finger, and the ends taper like a nib lifting off. It keeps undo and redo, clears with a wipe across the pad, replays the signature in its original rhythm, and exports a cropped PNG or SVG. A "Sign here" hint rests on the baseline until the first stroke. Keyboard: Mod+Z undoes, Shift+Mod+Z or Mod+Y redoes, and Delete clears.

members.name: signer
members.doc: Printed under the baseline, such as the signer's name.

members.name: hint
members.doc: Resting hint on the baseline before the first stroke.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Receives the strokes after every change.

members.name: fileName
members.doc: File name for exports, without extension.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the drawing surface.
